# Namaste Long Island
> A community guide to South Asian life on Long Island, New York: wedding vendors, events, a festival guide, restaurants, shops, temples, gurdwaras and community groups. Run by Wealth Edge Ventures Inc.. Listings are free and verified with the business or on its own website.

## Pages
- [Namaste Long Island: South Asian weddings, festivals, food and events on Long Island](https://namastelongisland.com/): A community guide to South Asian life on Long Island: wedding vendors, festival guide, events, restaurants, shops, temples and gurdwaras, checked by a real person.
- [South Asian wedding vendors on Long Island](https://namastelongisland.com/weddings/): Find and list Long Island vendors for South Asian weddings: venues, caterers, mandap decor, DJs and dhol, photographers, mehndi, makeup, attire, jewelers and pandits.
- [South Asian events on Long Island: Diwali, garba, galas](https://namastelongisland.com/events/): Upcoming South Asian community events on Long Island, from temple festivals to Diwali galas, each linked to the organizer. Submit your event free.
- [South Asian festival guide for Long Island: Diwali, Navratri, Holi, Eid, Vaisakhi](https://namastelongisland.com/festivals/): When Diwali, Navratri, Ganesh Chaturthi, Holi, Eid, Vaisakhi and other South Asian festivals fall, and how Long Island celebrates them.
- [South Asian restaurants, sweets and catering on Long Island](https://namastelongisland.com/eat/): Indian, Pakistani, Bangladeshi, Sri Lankan, Nepali and Indo-Caribbean restaurants, mithai shops and caterers on Long Island. Owners list free.
- [South Asian groceries, sarees, jewelry and puja supplies on Long Island](https://namastelongisland.com/shop/): Where to shop for South Asian groceries, festival and wedding clothes, jewelry and puja supplies on Long Island.
- [Hindu temples, gurdwaras and South Asian community groups on Long Island](https://namastelongisland.com/temples-community/): Mandirs, gurdwaras and South Asian community organizations on Long Island, with addresses and hours checked on their own websites.
- [Get listed free](https://namastelongisland.com/get-listed/): Add your South Asian wedding business, restaurant, shop, temple or association to Namaste Long Island. Basic listings are free.
- [Claim your listing](https://namastelongisland.com/claim/): Business owners and organizers: claim your Namaste Long Island listing to update details and add photos.
- [Submit an event free](https://namastelongisland.com/submit-event/): Add your South Asian community event on Long Island to the Namaste Long Island calendar and weekly email. Free.
- [Weekly newsletter](https://namastelongisland.com/newsletter/): A free weekly email of South Asian events, festivals, food and wedding finds on Long Island.
- [About](https://namastelongisland.com/about/): Who runs Namaste Long Island, how listings are verified, and how free and paid placements work.
- [Privacy](https://namastelongisland.com/privacy/): How Namaste Long Island uses analytics and the information you send through its forms.
